AcceptedService.description:

escrow, payment, insurance or logistics providers found in the registry.

AgentCheckoutObservation.description: One probe result recorded by ONAA's checker (admin only). Probes stop before payment: no order is placed.

AgentCheckoutRequirements.description: What the probe observed an agent needs to reach checkout and pay at this store ("how to buy here").

accepted_agents_hint.description: which agents the store appears to serve when it refuses anonymous agents, inferred from its manifest. Not confirmed

agent_profile_required.description: UCP-Agent profile URL must be sent

autonomous_payment.description: after_one_time_link: the store offers a Shop Pay one-time link the buyer approves once (identity linking); later unattended payment is not verified; none_observed: every offered handler needs the buyer per purchase or undocumented approval; not_offered: no agent payment handler at checkout

buyer_confirmation_required.description: checkout asked for the buyer's own input or approval (requires_escalation)
buyer_confirmation_required.title: Buyer Confirmation Required

delivery_test.description: address: delivery was tested with a public test address per country (results without it could not tell 'no delivery' from 'no address given')

manifest_payment_handlers.description: payment handler namespaces in the store's UCP manifest, e.g. com.google.pay, dev.shopify.shop_pay
manifest_payment_handlers.title: Manifest Payment Handlers

no_shipping_to.description: tested countries where the checkout reported no delivery
no_shipping_to.title: No Shipping To

payment_handlers.description: handler ids offered at checkout, e.g. shopify.card, shop_pay, gpay

published_ships_to.description: countries the store itself publishes as shipping destinations (Shopify /meta.json). Store-published, not tested by ONAA

published_ships_worldwide.description: the store's own published shipping list includes rest of world. Store-published, not tested by ONAA

shipping_quotes.description: cheapest shipping option per tested country for the one test item: an example, not a price for your order

ships_to.description: tested countries (ISO 3166-1) where a checkout reported delivery

DiscoveredServiceCreate.description:
A publicly documented provider (payment, escrow, logistics, ...) that has not registered itself.

No endpoint is required: many providers publish docs but no agent endpoint. Shown as `discovered`
(unclaimed, not registered, not endorsed) with provenance until the provider registers or opts out.

human_approval.description: Where a person must act, as the provider's public docs describe it (stored as commerce.human_approval). Observed by ONAA, not declared by the provider.

payment_methods.description: Agent-usable payment methods the provider's public docs describe (stored as commerce.payment_terms.methods). Observed by ONAA, not declared by the provider.
payment_methods.title: Payment Methods

payment_networks.description: e.g. visa, mastercard, usdc, x402, ap2
payment_networks.title: Payment Networks

DiscoveredServiceCreate.title: DiscoveredServiceCreate

HumanApproval.description:
Where a person must act. Self-declared by the listing (or observed by ONAA from public docs for a
discovered provider); never verified and not a trust level. Omitted fields mean "not stated".

escrow_release.description: Escrow providers: who releases or refunds held funds. automatic (the parties' agents over an API or contract), evaluator (a named third-party agent or contract decides), human (provider staff or a party's person must act).
escrow_release.title: Escrow Release

per_payment.description: For each payment: none (the agent pays on its own, within limits a person may have set once at setup), pre_authorized (a person approves each purchase intent or mandate BEFORE the agent pays; the agent then completes it alone), per_transaction (a person confirms each payment while it happens, e.g. checkout page, bank strong authentication, PIN).
per_payment.title: Per Payment

setup.description: One-time steps a person completes before an agent can use the service: none, identity_check (KYC/KYB, may be automated), application_review (the provider reviews and approves the use, e.g. card issuing programmes), partner_agreement (a signed contract or partner programme), account_funding (a person tops up a balance or sets limits in advance).

info.description: Find stores and marketplaces where AI buying agents reach checkout, with each store's tested checkout requirements (UCP, Shop MCP); links only. Also lists payment and other providers and buyer and seller agents. This directory API holds listings and trust metadata only; it never relays buyer/seller transactions, holds funds, or hosts seller data.
